reference_implementation_a.sql: SELECT e.provider_id,SUM(c.amount) AS billed_amount FROM encounters e JOIN procedures p ON p.encounter_id=e.encounter_id JOIN charges c ON c.procedure_id=p.procedure_id WHERE e.status='completed' GROUP BY e.provider_id ORDER BY e.provider_id

reference_implementation_b.sql: SELECT provider_id,billed_amount FROM (SELECT e.provider_id,SUM(c.amount) AS billed_amount FROM charges c JOIN procedures p ON p.procedure_id=c.procedure_id JOIN encounters e ON e.encounter_id=p.encounter_id AND e.status='completed' GROUP BY e.provider_id) q ORDER BY provider_id
